experiment_data.hypothesis: Wide single critic ablation: if CIVO suppression in exp_032 (dual-critic) is due to parameter count/regularization rather than pessimistic min operation, then a single critic with 2× parameters should also suppress CIVO. If wide-critic fails (CIVO persists) but dual-critic succeeds → min operation has implicit regularization effect beyond pessimism.
